stages.hours_note: estimate; part of PowerPyx's 60–80 h story total
steps: Finish Gone Fishing (Just Like Paradise) and play through Chapter 1.
Morning after Down to Earth: do Lucia's balcony meditation — the only possibly-missable step in the game (see Positive Mental Attitude).
After Feng Shui, follow Cal's fishing quests (Baited My Tackle) and meet Kenton to start his 7-shipwreck treasure line.
Play an arcade game on the home TV whenever you like (Stick Fiddler) — the first three games are there from Chapter 1.
Scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study animals with binoculars as you go — the counts carry into the 100% checklist.
stages.title: Chapter 1 — learn Leonida, do the one thing you cannot redo

stages.hours_note: estimate; part of PowerPyx's 60–80 h story total
steps: Finish Chapters 2 and 3 (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist).
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2) you can switch characters and free-roam together — partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) and duo training unlock from here.

Start Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub, after Coffee Break), Andy (Lucia-only, Chapter 3), Randy (after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS), Tyrone (Jason-only, after Here, Kitty Kitty), and do the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling for the 3 valuables.
Unlock the Scooter Bros app (Moses, Chapter 2) and the Vice City Real Estate app (after Daily Driver) and start buying garages and registering vehicles.
stages.title: Chapters 2–3 — Vice City opens up; start the side lines

stages.hours_note: estimate; part of PowerPyx's 60–80 h story total
steps: Finish Chapters 4 and 5 (Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) and the final mission — keep a manual save before the finale.

Do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it unlocks bank-vault robberies and counts as the armored-truck robbery; vaults pay up to $205,000 and feed the $250,000 laundering total.
Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) for the Dye Pack Jammer so marked bills can be laundered at fences.
Bank-vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level, so Hot Together should pop on its own here; use the same runs for Retail Therapy's 3-shop streak.
stages.title: Chapters 4–5 — the finale; bank vaults open

steps: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work the list: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts — plus in full: all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all underwater discoveries, every shooting-range gold, all 42 drone races, all 15 Target Decks.

Grind order that saves time: unfog the map by plane first (The Goodtime State), then stunts (under-bridge flights are fastest), WAiNK scans (100), drone races (finish all races at each of the 14 locations in one visit), shooting ranges (42 golds), then challenges (pick the easiest remaining).
Work Bret's hunting line through while you are out in the world — his 15 Target Decks are needed in full, and Fair Game rides along with them.
A Long Road pops when the checklist is done; it is the hardest trophy and usually the last one before cleanup.
stages.title: 100% completion — the long grind (checklist appears after the story)

stages.hours_note: estimate; PowerPyx Step 3, about 10 h plus the one-off feats
steps: Finish the 8 counting stranger strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; more are still being found — check the Strangers & Freaks entry).

Mop up the one-off feats: Combat Focus x5 (Gunslinger), the VCIA jet (Catch Me If You Can), the Rhino tank (Challenging Tank), the undetected jewelry robbery (Sneakthief), Kingpin Bowling's 3 valuables if any are left, max Strength for both characters (Personal Best) and 500 Criminal Profile actions (Actions Speak Louder).
Steal the blue Banshee through the showroom window (Capital Offense) — it needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3.

Four trophies have no confirmed method in either cited guide yet (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) — check their entries before chasing them; they may need a post-launch update.
Spend the $100,000 across shops (Treat Yo Self), then Vice Got a Price! pops with the last trophy.
stages.title: Strangers & Freaks and misc cleanup — the platinum

title: Roadmap to the platinum — Vice Got a Price!
total_estimate_note: Estimate only: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and estimates about 200 hours to the platinum — story 60–80 hours, the 100% checklist about 100 hours, and Strangers & Freaks plus cleanup about 10 hours. Your time will vary.
warnings: THE ONE WARNING: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and accept her meditation (Positive Mental Attitude). It is gone after Chapter 1 and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy. Do it.

There is no mission replay and no New Game+, but free-roam continues after the story and every trophy except possibly the Chapter 1 meditation stays earnable. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots; PowerPyx recommends 10 saves for chapter starts and ends) so a missed step never costs a full replay.
Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off for the whole run (PowerPyx, GTABase). Avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.

There are no difficulty settings, no mission gold medals and no online trophies. One playthrough is enough. The four unconfirmed trophies (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin) have no verified method yet — do not chase guesses for them; their entries say so plainly.
